title: Detailed pancakes
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='plate' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c8d8e8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8aa8c8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='golden' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8a838'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c07818'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='golden2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f0b848'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d08820'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='butter' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff8d0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f0d850'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='syrup' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c86818'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8a3a08'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- plate -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='42' ry='10' fill='url(#plate)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='38' ry='8' fill='#dce8f4'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='79' rx='34' ry='6' fill='#eef4fa'/>

  <!-- bottom pancake -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='32' ry='12' fill='url(#golden)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='32' ry='11' fill='url(#golden2)'/>
  <!-- bottom pancake edge shade -->
  <path d='M18 70 Q50 84 82 70' stroke='#a86010' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>

  <!-- second pancake -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='11' fill='url(#golden)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='30' ry='10' fill='url(#golden2)'/>
  <path d='M20 60 Q50 74 80 60' stroke='#a86010' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>

  <!-- third pancake -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='28' ry='10' fill='url(#golden)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='28' ry='9' fill='url(#golden2)'/>
  <path d='M22 50 Q50 64 78 50' stroke='#a86010' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>

  <!-- fourth pancake -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='26' ry='9' fill='url(#golden)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='26' ry='8' fill='url(#golden2)'/>
  <path d='M24 40 Q50 54 76 40' stroke='#a86010' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>

  <!-- top pancake -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='24' ry='8' fill='url(#golden)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='24' ry='7' fill='url(#golden2)'/>
  <path d='M26 30 Q50 44 74 30' stroke='#a86010' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>

  <!-- syrup drip over top -->
  <path d='M30 30 Q32 36 34 30' fill='url(#syrup)'/>
  <path d='M44 28 Q46 38 48 28' fill='url(#syrup)'/>
  <path d='M60 30 Q62 37 64 29' fill='url(#syrup)'/>
  <path d='M68 32 Q69 38 70 31' fill='url(#syrup)'/>
  <!-- syrup pool on top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='29' rx='20' ry='5' fill='url(#syrup)' opacity='0.85'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='28' rx='12' ry='3' fill='#d87828' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- butter pat -->
  <rect x='40' y='22' width='18' height='7' rx='2' fill='url(#butter)'/>
  <rect x='41' y='23' width='16' height='2' rx='1' fill='#fffce8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <rect x='40' y='27' width='18' height='2' rx='1' fill='#e0c840'/>

  <!-- syrup running down side -->
  <path d='M26 31 Q24 40 26 48 Q28 52 27 56' stroke='#b05510' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 32 Q74 38 73 45' stroke='#b05510' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- pancake pore details -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='45' r='1.5' fill='#c08018' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#c08018' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='58' r='1.2' fill='#c08018' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='65' r='1.3' fill='#c08018' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='68' r='1.2' fill='#c08018' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='36' r='1.2' fill='#c08018' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='44' r='1' fill='#c08018' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='48' r='1' fill='#c08018' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- highlight on top pancake -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='28' rx='10' ry='3' fill='#ffd870' opacity='0.35'/>
</svg>
